items.name: Wanderer-VR
items.description: This Android VR Application was created during "Unreal Engine 4 Summer Jam 2017". This Game is built on the Unreal Engine 4 (4.16) This is completely based on C++ and Unreal Visual Scripts (Blueprints) and has a Release APK for Installation. This application is a Standalone Android Application which will provide a VR Experience of a different Planet just using Google Cardboard Headset.

items.name: APK-VR-Breaking-Bad
items.description: This is a project to recreate an iconic environment respecting the low poly of my favorite series: Breaking Bad. Objects were modeled in Blender, developed in Unity and integrated with Google Cardboard. It was developed as a final project for the subject "Computer graphics and virtual reality" in my Computer Science college at UNA. Jun 2025.
